title: ENISA Single Reporting Platform (SRP) manuals and reporting instructions

metadata.freshness_note: ENISA's SRP supports mandatory Article 14 reporting from 2026-09-11. ENISA announced SRP manuals/instructions "in the course of June 2026" per the CRA search results. The SRP topic landing page exists; no manual document URL confirmed at verification time. Revisit once ENISA publishes the manuals. License provisionally `ENISA-CC-BY-4` on the host whitelist (enisa.europa.eu); since this is status: planned with no fetchable PDF yet, license_evidence_url points at the ENISA website notice — the per-document inside-cover CC BY 4.0 notice MUST be confirmed at ingestion before the row flips to published (ENISA-agency PDFs carry it, but the website notice alone is acknowledgement-only).
